_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Ralph T. H. Griffith (1826-1906). Valmiki's Ramayana in English verse (1870-74) and the Hymns of the Rigveda (2nd ed., Lazarus, Benares 1896-97). PD. Added 2026-10-03 by lane C (round 6) under the coordinator's standing instruction to choose further translator shelves; Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted in the relay burst.

_name_words_note: Translator name(s) only: fetch_shelf.py treats these as the identity check (one must appear in the fetched text), so the original author's name is deliberately NOT listed.
_verified_note: Evidence that each source's rights/identity line was read (lane C review fix, 2026-10-02, pipeline run over the fetched files; no book text recorded). PG: the header's Translator: line and the COPYRIGHTED marker. IA: whether the translator's name appears in the first 30 KB of OCR, and the years printed in the first 15 KB of front matter (scanner/digitizer lines skipped). Any post-1930 year there was examined by eye; see the title's scan_edition.
_surname_note: 2026-10-03: full printed names only, after Lane D's name audit (a bare one-word form would pass other authors of the same surname, e.g. Maude Ashurst Biggs). Tested against every source on the shelf; the only misses already carry _identity_checked overrides.

griffith-samaveda.author: The preface is signed 'T. II. GRIFFITH.' in the OCR (H read as II), and the Benares Lazarus imprint matches. Checked by eye 2026-10-17.
